name: retroshelf
summary: Records Knulli play sessions and syncs them to your retroshelf account.

notes: Requires a retroshelf account and Wi-Fi for linking and syncing. Upstream documents offline session queuing and a game-session hook installed on first launch.

Review on 2026-10-23 verified the version-pinned Knulli v0.5.5 ZIP against the GitHub asset digest: 18970733 bytes, SHA-256 927abed445f487cd31faee77809561bf09b390e166c13194cc1958146dcdeb1e. No packaged code was executed.

The packaged launcher applies staged updates and can execute a staged sync engine. Store-managed updates must remain within the Store's pinned checksum and transaction controls; these paths need review and disabling before installation can be enabled.

A redistributable license has not been verified. The public release repository links to a source repository that returned HTTP 404 during review. Runtime dependencies, write containment, preserved credentials and session data, hook ownership, and uninstall behavior remain unverified.

Upstream installs under /userdata/roms/tools/retroshelf and records game sessions through hooks under /userdata/system/scripts. Its uninstall instructions require bin/retroshelf-uninstall.sh before deleting the app folder. Safe hook cleanup and data preservation need lifecycle review; no device compatibility or lifecycle results are claimed.

evidence.note: Documents account linking, offline queuing, Tools installation, session hooks, and uninstall order. Device support is an upstream claim, not Store device-test evidence.
Public release repository at the v0.5.5 tag; README links to https://github.com/ruigomeseu/retroshelf, which returned HTTP 404 during review. No license was verified.

Downloaded ZIP matches the GitHub asset size and SHA-256. Launcher inspection found staged-update application, staged-engine execution, and automatic hook repair. Archive integrity alone does not establish runtime safety.
